ai.seo_question: What is the significance of maintaining the Ka'bah according to Imam Ali's last will?
ai.summary: In his final testament to his sons, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the Ka'bah as the spiritual axis of the Muslim community, urging them to preserve its sanctity and presence as a source of divine connection. This exhortation reflects the Shia understanding of the Ahl al-Bayt's role as guardians of religious symbols, linking physical devotion to spiritual accountability. The warning against neglect underscores the gravity of maintaining the visible signs of monotheism as a prerequisite for standing before God without dispute.

en.sayed-ali-raza: (Fear) Allāh (and) keep Allāh in view in the matter of your Lord’s House (Ka‘bah).
Do not forsake it so long as you live,
because if it is abandoned you will not be spared.
